title: Connecting people already in the tree
changes: Two people already in the family tree can be connected to each other — previously a relationship could only be recorded while adding someone new.
Right-click a person and choose "Connect to someone in the tree", pick the relationship, then search the people already recorded.
Editing a person now lists the families they belong to, so a wrong link can be removed or a new one added without deleting anyone.
Naming a second parent for someone who already has one now works — the relative joins that person's existing family instead of being refused.
Links a family record genuinely cannot hold — a third parent, two siblings already in different families, a duplicate partnership — are shown as unavailable with the reason.
